name: audivo
description: Podcast transcripts in one call: ask for an episode by name or link and get its transcript, to summarise, quote or search.

interface.longDescription: Ask for a podcast episode by name, Apple Podcasts link or RSS feed, and Audivo transcribes it and hands the transcript back, a page at a time, to summarise, quote or search. Episodes already transcribed come back at once. Signing in connects your Audivo account; transcription spends your Audivo credits, about one per audio minute.
defaultPrompt: Transcribe the latest episode of Acquired and summarise it in five bullet points.
Find the episode of Lex Fridman with Andrej Karpathy and pull out every quote about education.
What did the last three episodes of Hard Fork say about AI regulation?
